items.notes: All five core claims are answered and each is backed by the supplied quotes on cost proxy, placement, separated controls, goodput, and delayed or failed-controller handling.
The answer omits the 20-connection 0.10 s/0.25 s arithmetic (200/s to 80/s) and the remove-all-60-slots recovery test, and the supplied quote supports only part of those claims.
The matrix-column and full selection-checklist claims are only partly evidenced by the supplied quotes, although the answer itself walks through the selection record and the two-representation costs.
All six core claims are answered and the quotes directly support the objective definitions, restore limits, reconciliation duties, and drill evidence record.
The answer omits the earlier application-side staleness, thundering-herd, and inconsistent-read symptoms, and several topology and consistency quotes cover only adjacent mechanisms.
All five core claims are answered and supported by the composition, partial-result, retry, maintained-read-model, and BFF quotes.
The hexagonal-versus-layered variant taxonomy in core claim 3 is neither supplied with evidence nor addressed, and the local/remote adapter-classification clause is only partially supported.

The AWS, IBM, and HashiCorp provider details and the unreachable-registry or lost-IaC-state failure lack supporting quotes and are absent from the answer, though the image, instance, and rollback record rules are covered.
The answer omits the Sobol and confidence-interval-coverage limits, and the supplied quotes support only part of the matrix-coverage and recorded-limit claims.
The A/C amplification values and the timeout-longer-than-caller-deadline exclusion lack supporting quotes, and the answer does not state that deadline limitation.
